material_change.problem: The original generic protocol::parse validates COUNT arithmetic and LAW requests before a later Request::Chart match can reject them.
material_change.change: Reject non-CHART command tags using starts_with(b"RC1 CHART ") before original parsing; no replacement field/number/frame grammar.
material_change.effect: Any accepted candidate enters only the original CHART grammar/source validation/row compiler. Other command tags return ChartRequestRequired without generic COUNT/LAW validation.

reviewed_invariants.name: one_owned_snapshot
reviewed_invariants.source: Private original_request Vec<u8>, Chart and Compiled are constructed together; accessors return shared references, with no public mutation or external process-origin claim.

reviewed_invariants.name: dimension_and_coordinate_ranges
reviewed_invariants.source: Original CHART parser bounds v,e,h independently<=32 and total V+E+1+h<=32. Population::Edge and hybrid selectors check original lengths; ancestral selector uses the one original E continuation index.

reviewed_invariants.name: row_identity
reviewed_invariants.source: The adapter stores the exact original Compiled rows without reordering/deduplication; shape checks require original dimension, every row length, row cap and bank-name count.

reviewed_invariants.name: bounded_input_and_algebra
reviewed_invariants.source: Original CHART parser enforces65536B ASCII/newline/canonical fields, canonical rationals<=256bits,<=32 caller chronology entries and<=32 exposure entries; original row compiler enforces128 rows.

reviewed_invariants.name: failure_semantics
reviewed_invariants.source: Tag, parsing, compiler and shape errors are unavailability/refusal; none is a mathematical infeasibility verdict.

reviewed_invariants.name: build_interface
reviewed_invariants.source: Original lib.rs publicly exports natural_cell/protocol/affine and q; Chart/Compiled/Row implement the traits required by adapter derives. This is source compatibility, not an actual compiler result.

exact_row_count.definitions: n=complete leaf registry size, h=complete hybrid registry size; endpoint_count counts present lower/upper bounds separately, retaining every occurrence/duplicate.
exact_row_count.meaning: Chronology/exposure/coin interval rows can exhaust128 independently of32 coordinate capacity. Counts do not prove source/chart admission.

remaining: Exact typed original source/registry/layout/emission relation, M0/readout substitution proof, native refinement, actual compiled objects/tests and encrypted writer admission remain open.
